name: Bring the End
label: Quest
description: Bring the End: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In the Barrens lies a horrid mess of tangled vines called Razorfen Downs. While our first observations of this place revealed little threat, our recent findings are much more serious...

The quilboar of Razorfen Downs have aligned themselves with the Scourge. A Lich named Amnennar the Coldbringer rules them now, using the power of his massive consciousness to control their every move.
Amnennar has a direct telepathic link to Ner'zhul; we must sever this bond, friend. An end must come to the Coldbringer.

clips.title: Progress
paras: This matter is of utmost importance, friend. We must stop any attempt by the Scourge to bolster their ranks.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The loyalty of a Lich is unswerving, friend. Let them know that such loyalty will only bring them destruction.
